reliability: Public vendor page read directly with curl; HTTP 200. Primary evidence of advertised scope only, not independently tested functionality or customer demand.
findings: The vendor describes integration with QuickBooks Pro, Premier or Enterprise and Intuit Basic, Enhanced or Assisted Payroll.
The product page lists WH-347/WH-348 reporting and electronic submission compatibility with LCPtracker, Elation Systems, California DIR, AASHTO and other systems.
The vendor says QuickBooks holds employee/job/time/payroll data while CPS holds additional employee, job, payroll-wage-item and deduction data in linked records, then merges information for reports.
limitations: Page shows Last Updated 03 November 2025 but also older product narrative and form references; current version coverage requires confirmation. Original publication date unknown.
Additional linked-record configuration demonstrates a product data model, not measured ongoing duplicate work or a defect.
Marketing claims of time savings or compatibility were not installed/tested; no pricing is relied on.
No independent small-contractor time/cost measurement, failure rate or willingness-to-pay evidence.
